work_order.root_cause: Two distinct causes, and the refused revision resolved the second one on the wrong side. BUG-1 (minor): the rewrite deleted the single <h2 id="debts-heading"> (main page.tsx:320) while the two refusal links in components/groups-panels.tsx:511,755 were reused verbatim, so both dangle; the v1 plan never rechecked the fragment target against the rewritten page. BUG-2 (major): the v1 work order wrote two mutually exclusive demands into one plan — a whole-page app/groups/[id]/loading.tsx boundary (IAC-6) and a QA-derived synchronous scriptless ledger (AC-7 no-JS clause plus qa_script plus residual-risk assumption). Under App Router streaming those cannot coexist in one route segment: the boundary streams its fallback visibly while the resolved ledger waits in a hidden Flight payload (template#B:0 plus display:none DIV#S:0) for a client-JS $RC swap that never runs scriptless, exactly as the in-repo T-14 DOM shows. The mistaken premise was the scriptless guarantee, not the skeleton: docs/ui.md Group page loading and IAC-6 require the whole-page skeleton, while no-JS appears nowhere in the issue or ui.md. So the skeleton stays (restoring IAC-6's letter in AC-6/AC-9 with matching unit pins) and the QA-derived guarantee is scoped to JS-enabled paint, with the boundary carrying a <noscript> notice so scriptless readers get a designed message rather than a bare loader.

On BUG-1 v1 was merely incomplete: it reused the refusal hrefs verbatim without rechecking their #debts-heading fragment against the rewritten page that deletes it. issue_snapshot.title: Group page with sections, expenses list and settings entry
issue_snapshot.body:
A group member finds the balance, the expenses, and the next action without scrolling one long stack, with Add expense always one tap away.

UI face: group member sees one organised page (summary plus tabbed Expenses, Balances and settle up, Activity, Members) with Add expense always reachable and settings tucked behind Settings. Contract face: consumes shell, tokens, rows, cards, segmented control, dialogs, and skeletons from piece 1; reuses existing group, expense-list, balance, and activity-excerpt reads with no endpoint or schema change. Follows docs/ui.md Group page structure and states exactly.

**Out of scope**
- Expense editor form internals and settle-up sheet internals (next piece)
- Balance-math, simplification, filter semantics, or activity-writing changes

review.title: A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.
review.detail:
A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.

`lib/groups/validation.ts:165`

Evidence: lib/groups/validation.ts:165 does (raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Next.js delivers searchParams values as string | string[], so ?section=expenses&section=balances hands groupSectionFrom a string[], on which .trim() throws TypeError. GroupPage parses section at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:119 before the ledger try/catch, so the throw escapes to the route error boundary rather than rendering the expenses panel that AC-2/AC-10 require for malformed input.

Fix: Coerce before trimming, e.g. const value = (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Note activityFilterFrom and expenseFiltersFrom share the pattern; fixing only the new parser leaves the same crash on ?activity= and ?q=.

review.title: On a failed /activity read, the filter chips drop the ?group= scope even when it is known, and the retry drops it whenever the groups read itself failed.
review.detail:
On a failed /activity read, the filter chips drop the ?group= scope even when it is known, and the retry drops it whenever the groups read itself failed.

`app/activity/page.tsx:127`

Evidence: app/activity/page.tsx:127 renders <FilterChips filter={filter} action="/activity" /> with no preserved prop in the failed branch, while the success branch (:154) passes preserved={...ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM...}. Fix: Pass the same preserved map in the failed branch (lift scoped-or-raw-group computation above the failed/success split), and build the retry href from the raw query group param as fallback when groups failed to load, e.g. activityHref(filter, scoped?.id ?? query[ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM] ?? null).
